5 things to know before you play GTA 6:

- Unlocks at midnight local time
- Pre-load is up to 212 GB
- Targets 30 FPS on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S
- Also on Xbox Cloud Gaming, with Remote Play
- Free printable Leonida map on the official site Nov 19
